title.zh: 犹他州的Bathyurellus：奥陶纪的三叶虫线索
title.en: Bathyurellus in Utah: an Ordovician trilobite clue

answer.zh: 美国犹他州的一条采集记录，给出了奥陶纪三叶虫Bathyurellus pogonipensis的地点证据。
answer.en: A collection record from Utah, USA, gives locality evidence for the Ordovician trilobite Bathyurellus pogonipensis.

explanation.zh: 三叶虫是已经灭绝的海生节肢动物，身体纵向分为中轴和两侧肋叶三部分，这也是名称的来源。本条示意图只表达一般的三叶虫体形，不是该种的复原。PBDB把这条采集登记为该种出现，所引文献是Ross 1949年关于犹他州东北部Garden City组三叶虫动物群分带的研究；数据库保留的字段没有注明这次采集所属的地层单位，因此本条不把该地点断定为Garden City组。
explanation.en: Trilobites are extinct marine arthropods whose bodies divide lengthwise into a central axis and two side lobes, the source of their name. The artwork conveys only a general trilobite body plan and is not a restoration of this species. PBDB registers this collection as an occurrence of the species and cites Ross (1949) on trilobite faunal zones of the Garden City Formation in northeastern Utah; the retained database fields do not name the collection's rock unit, so this entry does not assert that the locality lies in the Garden City Formation.

text.zh: PBDB记录occ:2782、采集记录col:298引用Ross 1949年发表在American Journal of Science的Garden City组三叶虫动物群分带研究，鉴定为Bathyurellus pogonipensis。
text.en: PBDB occurrence occ:2782, collection col:298, cites Ross (1949) in the American Journal of Science on trilobite faunal zones of the Garden City Formation and is identified as Bathyurellus pogonipensis.

text.zh: 记录的地层年龄为471.3至457.3 Ma，标签为北美区域阶Whiterockian；采集坐标为40.163334°N、110.402222°W，数据库未注明地理尺度。
text.en: The record's stratigraphic envelope is 471.3-457.3 Ma, labelled with the North American regional stage Whiterockian; the collection coordinates are 40.163334°N, 110.402222°W, with no geographic scale stated.

caveats.zh: 470 Ma切片落在这条记录的年龄范围内，但范围约1400万年，不证明该三叶虫恰好生活在4.7亿年前，也不证明每一年都在同地出现。
caveats.en: The 470 Ma slice falls inside this record's age envelope, but the envelope spans about 14 million years; it does not show that the trilobite lived exactly 470 million years ago or was present here in every year.

caveats.zh: 本条沿用数据库的分类与文献出处，未重新核读原论文；记录选自按编号排序、最多80条的检索响应，不代表该时期最重要或最典型的产地。
caveats.en: This entry retains the database's classification and citation without rereading the original paper; it was selected from an ID-ordered query response capped at 80 rows and is not the period's most important or most typical locality.

timeNote.zh: 保留471.3至457.3 Ma的原始地层范围；约4.7亿年前是其中的浏览年代，不是单件标本的精确年龄。
timeNote.en: The original stratigraphic range of 471.3-457.3 Ma is retained. About 470 million years ago is a browsing age within it, not an exact date for an individual specimen.

precision.zh: PBDB文献采集坐标，未注明地理尺度；不是该动物的分布范围，实测位置误差未知。
precision.en: Published collection coordinates for which PBDB states no geographic scale, not a distribution range for the animal; measured positional uncertainty is unknown.

title.zh: 挪威Oslo-Asker地区的Mucronaspis：奥陶纪末的三叶虫
title.en: Mucronaspis in the Oslo-Asker district: a trilobite from the end of the Ordovician

answer.zh: 挪威Oslo-Asker地区的采集记录，给出了奥陶纪最后一个阶Hirnantian中三叶虫Mucronaspis的地点证据；鉴定只到属。
answer.en: A collection from the Oslo-Asker district, Norway, gives locality evidence for the trilobite Mucronaspis in the Hirnantian, the last stage of the Ordovician; the identification is to genus only.

explanation.zh: Hirnantian阶常与奥陶纪末的冰期和生物灭绝联系在一起。这条PBDB记录引用的文献研究Oslo-Asker地区奥陶纪最末期海退层序中的生态组合，数据库登记为“Mucronaspis sp.”，即只鉴定到属、未定种。本条据此只说明该属在这一地区被记录过，不据此推断它与灭绝事件的关系；示意图在一般三叶虫体形上加了尾部尖突的概念，不是标本复原。
explanation.en: The Hirnantian stage is commonly associated with the end-Ordovician glaciation and extinctions. The literature cited by this PBDB record studies ecological associations in the latest Ordovician regressive sequence of the Oslo-Asker district, and the database records the identification as 'Mucronaspis sp.', meaning genus only with the species undetermined. The entry therefore shows only that the genus was recorded in this area and does not infer its relationship to the extinction; the artwork adds the concept of a pointed tail to a general trilobite body and is not a restoration of a specimen.

text.zh: PBDB记录occ:4209、采集记录col:364引用Brenchley与Cocks 1982年关于Oslo-Asker地区奥陶纪最末期海退层序生态组合的研究，鉴定为Mucronaspis sp.（属级）。
text.en: PBDB occurrence occ:4209, collection col:364, cites Brenchley and Cocks (1982) on ecological associations in the latest Ordovician regressive sequence of the Oslo-Asker district and is identified as Mucronaspis sp. (genus level).

text.zh: 记录的地层年龄为445.2至443.1 Ma，标签为Hirnantian；采集点标注为Oslo-Asker地区的local area，坐标为整数度60°N、11°E。
text.en: The record's stratigraphic envelope is 445.2-443.1 Ma, labelled Hirnantian; the collection is a 'local area' in the Oslo-Asker District at whole-degree coordinates of 60°N, 11°E.

caveats.zh: 445 Ma切片落在这条记录约210万年的年龄范围内，但不证明该三叶虫恰好生活在4.45亿年前；属级鉴定也不能说明是哪一个种。
caveats.en: The 445 Ma slice falls inside this record's age envelope of about 2.1 million years, but does not show that the trilobite lived exactly 445 million years ago; a genus-level identification cannot say which species was present.

caveats.zh: 本条沿用数据库的分类与文献出处，未重新核读原论文；坐标只是整度的地区代表点，不能定位到具体露头。
caveats.en: This entry retains the database's classification and citation without rereading the original paper; the coordinates are a whole-degree point for the district and cannot locate a specific outcrop.

timeNote.zh: 保留445.2至443.1 Ma的原始地层范围；约4.45亿年前是其中的浏览年代，不是单件标本的精确年龄。
timeNote.en: The original stratigraphic range of 445.2-443.1 Ma is retained. About 445 million years ago is a browsing age within it, not an exact date for an individual specimen.

precision.zh: PBDB标为local area、坐标只到整度的地区代表点；不是露头位置，也不是该动物的分布范围，实测位置误差未知。
precision.en: A district point classified by PBDB as 'local area' with whole-degree coordinates; not an outcrop position or a distribution range for the animal, and measured positional uncertainty is unknown.

title.zh: 加拿大西北地区的Phacops：早泥盆世的大眼三叶虫
title.en: Phacops in Canada's Northwest Territories: a big-eyed Early Devonian trilobite

answer.zh: 加拿大西北地区Natla河附近的采集记录，给出了早泥盆世三叶虫Phacops natlensis的地点证据。
answer.en: A collection near the Natla River in Canada's Northwest Territories gives locality evidence for the Early Devonian trilobite Phacops natlensis.

explanation.zh: Phacops所在的类群以复眼中较大且彼此分开的晶状体著称，示意图因此突出表现大眼和隆起的头部中央，但只是一般概念，不是该种的复原。PBDB把这条小型采集登记为该种出现，所引文献是Perry与Chatterton 1976年关于麦肯齐山脉Delorme组Emsian期地层中Phacops等三叶虫的研究；数据库保留的字段没有单独注明这次采集的地层单位。
explanation.en: The group containing Phacops is known for compound eyes made of relatively large, separate lenses, so the artwork emphasizes big eyes and a swollen central head region; it is only a general concept and not a restoration of this species. PBDB registers this small collection as an occurrence of the species and cites Perry and Chatterton (1976) on Phacops and other trilobites from Emsian beds of the Delorme Formation, Mackenzie Mountains; the retained database fields do not separately name the collection's rock unit.

text.zh: PBDB记录occ:48279、采集记录col:3920引用Perry与Chatterton 1976年发表在Canadian Journal of Earth Sciences的研究，鉴定为Phacops natlensis。
text.en: PBDB occurrence occ:48279, collection col:3920, cites Perry and Chatterton (1976) in the Canadian Journal of Earth Sciences and is identified as Phacops natlensis.

text.zh: 记录的地层年龄为410.62至399.5 Ma，标签为Early Emsian；采集描述为Natla河附近的small collection，坐标为63.279167°N、128.544449°W。
text.en: The record's stratigraphic envelope is 410.62-399.5 Ma, labelled Early Emsian; the collection is described as a 'small collection' near the Natla River at 63.279167°N, 128.544449°W.

caveats.zh: 400 Ma切片落在这条记录的年龄范围内，但范围约1110万年，不证明该三叶虫恰好生活在4亿年前；数值范围沿用数据库，不另行换算到其他年代表。
caveats.en: The 400 Ma slice falls inside this record's age envelope, but the envelope spans about 11.1 million years and does not show that the trilobite lived exactly 400 million years ago; the numeric range is the database's and is not converted to other timescales.

caveats.zh: 本条沿用数据库的分类与文献出处，未重新核读原论文；记录选自按编号排序、最多80条的检索响应，不代表该时期最重要或最典型的产地。
caveats.en: This entry retains the database's classification and citation without rereading the original paper; it was selected from an ID-ordered query response capped at 80 rows and is not the period's most important or most typical locality.

timeNote.zh: 保留410.62至399.5 Ma的原始地层范围；约4亿年前是其中的浏览年代，不是单件标本的精确年龄。
timeNote.en: The original stratigraphic range of 410.62-399.5 Ma is retained. About 400 million years ago is a browsing age within it, not an exact date for an individual specimen.

title.zh: 内布拉斯加的Ameura：石炭纪末仍有记录的三叶虫
title.en: Ameura in Nebraska: a trilobite still recorded at the end of the Carboniferous

answer.zh: 美国内布拉斯加Little Nemaha河边露头的采集记录，给出了晚石炭世三叶虫Ameura missouriensis的地点证据。
answer.en: A collection from an outcrop on the Little Nemaha River, Nebraska, USA, gives locality evidence for the Late Carboniferous trilobite Ameura missouriensis.

explanation.zh: 三叶虫在古生代早中期类群繁多，到石炭纪时只剩少数类群，通常都归入Proetida；Ameura就是这一晚期类群的成员。PBDB把这条露头采集登记为该种出现，所引文献是Pabian与Fagerstrom 1972年关于内布拉斯加东南部晚古生代三叶虫的研究。本条说明三叶虫在接近3亿年前仍有记录，但单条记录不能说明它们当时的数量或衰落过程；示意图只表达一般的三叶虫体形。
explanation.en: Trilobites were diverse in the early and middle Paleozoic, but by the Carboniferous only a few groups remained, usually all placed in the Proetida; Ameura is a member of this late group. PBDB registers this outcrop collection as an occurrence of the species and cites Pabian and Fagerstrom (1972) on Late Paleozoic trilobites from southeastern Nebraska. The entry shows that trilobites were still recorded close to 300 million years ago, but one record cannot show their abundance then or how they declined; the artwork conveys only a general trilobite body plan.

text.zh: PBDB记录occ:496317、采集记录col:50091引用Pabian与Fagerstrom 1972年发表在Journal of Paleontology的研究，鉴定为Ameura missouriensis。
text.en: PBDB occurrence occ:496317, collection col:50091, cites Pabian and Fagerstrom (1972) in the Journal of Paleontology and is identified as Ameura missouriensis.

text.zh: 记录的地层年龄为303.7至298.9 Ma，标签为Gzhelian；采集描述为Little Nemaha河边出露的outcrop（Sec. 11, T.8 N, R.8 E），坐标为40.676998°N、96.487°W。
text.en: The record's stratigraphic envelope is 303.7-298.9 Ma, labelled Gzhelian; the collection is an outcrop exposed on the Little Nemaha River (Sec. 11, T.8 N, R.8 E) at 40.676998°N, 96.487°W.

caveats.zh: 300 Ma切片落在这条记录约480万年的年龄范围内，但不证明该三叶虫恰好生活在3亿年前，也不证明每一年都在同地出现。
caveats.en: The 300 Ma slice falls inside this record's age envelope of about 4.8 million years, but does not show that the trilobite lived exactly 300 million years ago or was present here in every year.

caveats.zh: 本条沿用数据库的分类与文献出处，未重新核读原论文；同一检索中还有其他晚古生代三叶虫记录，本条不代表该时期最重要或最典型的产地。
caveats.en: This entry retains the database's classification and citation without rereading the original paper; the same query returned other Late Paleozoic trilobite records, and this one is not the period's most important or most typical locality.

timeNote.en: The original stratigraphic range of 303.7-298.9 Ma is retained. About 300 million years ago is a browsing age within it, not an exact date for an individual specimen.

title.zh: 密歇根Grand Ledge的鳞木：宾夕法尼亚亚纪的石松类树木
title.en: Lepidodendron at Grand Ledge, Michigan: a Pennsylvanian lycopsid tree

answer.zh: 美国密歇根Grand Ledge一处黏土制品公司采石场的采集记录，给出了石炭纪石松类树木Lepidodendron aculeatum的地点证据。
answer.en: A collection from a clay products company quarry at Grand Ledge, Michigan, USA, gives locality evidence for the Carboniferous lycopsid tree Lepidodendron aculeatum.

explanation.zh: 鳞木（Lepidodendron）是石炭纪煤沼森林中的高大石松类植物，不是松柏或开花树木；它的化石常以树皮上排列整齐的叶座印痕来识别和命名。PBDB把这条采集登记为该种出现，所引文献是Arnold 1949年的《Fossil Flora of the Michigan Coal Basin》。示意图只表达高大鳞木的一般形态，不是该标本的复原；单条记录也不能说明当地煤沼森林的组成。
explanation.en: Lepidodendron was a tall lycopsid plant of Carboniferous coal-swamp forests, not a conifer or flowering tree; its fossils are often recognized and named from the regular leaf-cushion patterns on the bark. PBDB registers this collection as an occurrence of the species and cites Arnold's 1949 Fossil Flora of the Michigan Coal Basin. The artwork conveys only the general form of a tall scale tree and is not a restoration of this specimen; one record also cannot establish the composition of the local coal-swamp forest.

text.zh: PBDB记录occ:131743、采集记录col:10889引用Arnold 1949年在密歇根大学古生物博物馆出版物中的《Fossil Flora of the Michigan Coal Basin》，鉴定为Lepidodendron aculeatum。
text.en: PBDB occurrence occ:131743, collection col:10889, cites Arnold's 1949 Fossil Flora of the Michigan Coal Basin in the University of Michigan Museum of Paleontology contributions and is identified as Lepidodendron aculeatum.

text.zh: 记录的地层年龄为323.4至298.9 Ma，标签为整个Pennsylvanian；采集描述为Grand Ledge Clay Products Co.采石场，坐标为42.75°N、84.849998°W。
text.en: The record's stratigraphic envelope is 323.4-298.9 Ma, labelled as the whole Pennsylvanian; the collection is described as the Grand Ledge Clay Products Co. quarry at 42.75°N, 84.849998°W.

caveats.zh: 300 Ma切片落在这条记录的年龄范围内，但范围约2450万年、覆盖整个宾夕法尼亚亚纪，不证明这件化石恰好属于3亿年前。
caveats.en: The 300 Ma slice falls inside this record's age envelope, but the envelope spans about 24.5 million years, the whole Pennsylvanian, and does not show that this fossil dates exactly to 300 million years ago.

caveats.zh: 本条沿用数据库的分类与文献出处，未重新核读原论文；记录选自按编号排序、最多80条的检索响应，不代表该时期最重要或最典型的产地。
caveats.en: This entry retains the database's classification and citation without rereading the original paper; it was selected from an ID-ordered query response capped at 80 rows and is not the period's most important or most typical locality.

timeNote.en: The original, very broad stratigraphic range of 323.4-298.9 Ma is retained. About 300 million years ago is a browsing age within it, not an exact date for an individual specimen.
